project.description: HuntAI QA · sends the COMPLETED webhook after full-flow-fail is final.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
set -eu set +x
UPSTREAM_JOB="full-flow-fail" INFO="" for _ in $(seq 1 30); do INFO="$(curl -fsS "http://127.0.0.1:8080/job/$UPSTREAM_JOB/lastBuild/api/json")" BUILDING="$(printf '%s' "$INFO" | jq -r '.building')" [ "$BUILDING" = "false" ] && break sleep 1 done BUILD_NUMBER="$(printf '%s' "$INFO" | jq -r '.number')" # Give the platform's initial trigger-side collector time to finish before the # completed webhook starts a second collection (the local harness avoids the # concurrent observation/collection race this way). sleep 8 RESULT="$(printf '%s' "$INFO" | jq -r '.result // "SUCCESS"')" case "$RESULT" in SUCCESS) STATUS="SUCCESS" ;; UNSTABLE|FAILURE) STATUS="FAILURE" ;; *) STATUS="ABORTED" ;; esac
BODY="$(printf '{"job":{"name":"%s"},"build":{"number":%s,"phase":"COMPLETED","status":"%s"}}' "$UPSTREAM_JOB" "$BUILD_NUMBER" "$STATUS")" SIG="$(printf '%s' "$BODY" | openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac "$JENKINS_WEBHOOK_SECRET" -r | cut -d' ' -f1)" curl -fsS -X POST "$HUNTAI_BASE_URL/api/v1/inbound-webhooks/$HUNTAI_CI_CONNECTOR_ID" \ -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ -H "x-hub-signature-256: sha256=$SIG" \ -H "x-github-delivery: jenkins-$UPSTREAM_JOB-$BUILD_NUMBER-completed" \ -H 'x-github-event: ci_build' \ --data-binary "$BODY" echo "notified platform: $UPSTREAM_JOB #$BUILD_NUMBER $STATUS"
